dataset: Generated synthetic scenes; pre-existing, not held out
sample_rate: 1 frame per second, from snapshot provenance
unit: Distinct camera/plate pair; matched if at least one stored prediction has the same camera and plate within the labeled time window
limitations: Synthetic corpus previously used for development; no held-out data or field deployment.
